niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” connected TV (CTV) advertising agency — the right partner depends on your goals, budget, geography, inventory preferences (direct buys vs programmatic), measurement needs, and whether you want creative + production help. To give a useful answer, tell me: campaign objective (brand awareness, reach, direct-response), budget, target markets, and whether you need creative or measurement services. Meanwhile, here’s a short guide to help you decide and some top options by use case.

Quick questions
- Objective: brand lift, reach, conversions, app installs, or local store visits?
- Budget: monthly or campaign-level?
- Geography: US, EMEA, APAC, local markets?
- Buying preference: programmatic (DSP) or direct-sold publisher deals?
- Need creative production and dynamic/ad personalization?
- Measurement requirements: attribution, third‑party verification, Nielsen DCR?

Who to consider by need
- Large, full-service/global CTV campaigns (cross-channel planning, premium inventory):
  - GroupM teams (Wavemaker, Mindshare), Omnicom (OMD, PHD), Publicis (Starcom), Dentsu (Carat), IPG (UM/Initiative).
  - Best when you have sizable budgets and need integrated TV + digital strategy and guaranteed premium buys.

- Programmatic / performance-focused CTV:
  - The Trade Desk (DSP + managed services), Amobee, MiQ, Tremor/ZZZ (programmatic video specialists).
  - Good for audience targeting, optimization, and measurable performance.

- Platform-native / publisher solutions (direct access to streaming inventory and first-party data):
  - Roku Advertising, Amazon Ads (Prime Video/Fire TV), Samsung Ads, Comcast Spotlight, Paramount/Roku/Hulu direct sales teams.
  - Best when you want premium audience slices and platform-specific packages.

- Creative + ad tech partners (interactive CTV, dynamic creative, ad serving):
  - Innovid, Extreme Reach, VideoAmp (measurement), DoubleVerify/Integral Ad Science (viewability/fraud), Nielsen (DCR).
  - Use these for creative personalization, reliable measurement and verification.

- Local and lower-budget programmatic:
  - Simpli.fi (addressable/local programmatic), local media agencies with CTV specialism.

How to choose (short checklist)
- KPIs: define primary and secondary metrics up front.
- Inventory & reach: ask which publishers and exchanges they access.
- Buying model & transparency: programmatic vs direct, placements, fees, data usage and reporting cadence.
- Targeting & frequency: addressable, household, geo, behavioral options and cap controls.
- Measurement & verification: viewability, fraud checks, cross‑device attribution, third‑party reporting.
- Creative capabilities: 16:9 vs 4:3 assets, interactive overlays, dynamic creative insertion.
- Case studies & references: request results from similar campaigns/verticals.

If you want, tell me your objective, market and budget and I’ll recommend 3–5 agencies/platform partners tailored to your needs (and a shortlist of questions to ask each).
